jobs.description: About Guidesly Guidesly is the first mobile app connecting anglers to our deep network of trusted fishing guides. We help customers create one-of-a-kind fishing experiences by allowing them to have immediate booking access to their own personal guide. Guidesly finds guides for every angler and every occasion, saltwater, freshwater, boating, drifting down a river or wading. The Guidesly app allows users to see lakes, rivers, oceans, and bodies of water, but also, all recent fishing and weather reports to find the best fishing spots specifically matched to their preferences. Then, users can start browsing through our network of certified fishing guides and book a customized fishing excursion with their guide. And first and foremost, we are a technology company developing the best consumer and guide products to change the outdoor enthusiast and guiding marketplace forever! Come join Guidesly and set cast on a new adventure! Job Description Job Title Senior React Native Full Stack Developer - Immediate Joining Job Summary Guidesly is looking for a Senior React Native developer to join our mobile team as an individual contributor, building and evolving our consumer and guide apps on iOS and Android. You will take ownership of features from design through release and ship polished, high-performance experiences that anglers and fishing guides rely on every day. We're looking for someone who is comfortable with a fast-moving environment, can learn quickly, and takes pride in apps that feel truly native. Job Details As a Senior Developer, you will help develop the next generation of our apps using tools such as React.js, React Native, TypeScript, Gatsby and Webpack, backed by native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) and Android (Kotlin/Java) code where deeper platform integration is needed. You will work closely with Product, Design and Backend teams on features such as interactive maps of lakes, rivers and oceans, live fishing and weather reports, guide discovery, real-time booking and payments. You should be deeply familiar with React and its ecosystem; prior experience owning a production React Native codebase is a strong plus. Responsibilities Build pixel-perfect, buttery smooth UIs across both mobile platforms. Leverage native APIs for deep integrations with both platforms. Diagnose and fix bugs and performance bottlenecks for performance that feels native.
